question: Which carried, attention, and MLP components prospectively strengthen the MLP4-induced final-query signal across blocks 6, 7, and 8 on the sealed lexical holdout?
data_status: The rows, native capability, writer, attention5 endpoint, and attention9 endpoint are open. Every block6/7/8 carried-attention-MLP factorial arm and Shapley value on these rows is unopened.
population: All 32 answer-changing A1/A2 rows from the immutable 64-row capable lexical/recombination holdout.

predictions.pred_a_authority_capability_and_exact_in: All hashes and terminals hold; bound and current native capability pass; native/manual, MLP4 tensor, per-boundary residual tensor, and full-factor/direct-query closures satisfy fixed tolerances.
predictions.pred_b_writer_recurrence: The writer mean remains within 0.01 of 0.2835613798, with positive A1/A2 means and at least 0.80 direction fraction.
predictions.pred_c_monotone_crossing_recurrence: Full block6, block7, and block8 crossings each have at least 0.75 A1/A2 direction fraction and rise strictly from the open attention5 all-head value through resid7, resid8, and resid9.
predictions.pred_d_active_strengthening_components: At every boundary, carried Shapley is positive, attention+MLP Shapley is at least 0.003, and at least one of attention or MLP has positive full-arm removal damage in both A1 and A2.
predictions.pred_e_exact_coverage: All 8 factorial arms plus one direct ceiling at all three boundaries and one writer arm produce exactly 896 finite records within 70 forwards and 1152 example evaluations, without fits, backwards, or updates.

terminal.screen: A-E pass: compile prospectively localized block6-8 strengthening components into the typed path.
terminal.null: The run is valid and writer recurs, but monotonic strengthening or active-component predictions fail.
terminal.invalid: Authority, capability, alignment, instrument closure, writer recurrence, finiteness, coverage, or price fails.

efficiency: One model load and shared base/writer captures support all three exact 3-factor decompositions; this replaces three separate GPU jobs and avoids a 64-arm six-factor factorial.
novelty: First prospective exact decomposition of the intermediate block6-8 amplification connecting the validated attention5 onset and attention9 reader branches.
